options.content: **GEO history: selected-range intersection with the frozen 3–10 Oct 2026 snapshot.** [View the full snapshot](/d/notra-accounting?from=2026-10-03T11:35:08.391Z&to=2026-10-10T11:35:08.391Z&var-environment=${environment}&var-organization=${organization:percentencode}). Gateway/BYOK accounting awaits telemetry activation. Reported usage is not invoice cash paid; never add scan totals to individual checks. Missing data is not zero. [Customer rankings and API latency](/d/notra-overview?${__url_time_range}&var-environment=${environment}&var-organization=${organization:percentencode}).

panels.title: Gateway, BYOK & balance · live collection pending
Gateway charges · collection pending
panels.description: Includes charges against free or purchased gateway credits; not cash payments. Deduplicates repeated generation lookups.

targets.expr: sum(max by (costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", organizationId="organizationId", costId="costId", gatewayCostUsd="gatewayCostUsd" | event="ai.cost.reported" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | costId!="" | unwrap gatewayCostUsd | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: BYOK usage · collection pending
panels.description: Provider-reported inference value, before provider credits, discounts and invoice adjustments. Not cash paid.

targets.expr: sum(max by (costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", organizationId="organizationId", costId="costId", byokInferenceCostUsd="byokInferenceCostUsd" | event="ai.cost.reported" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | costId!="" | unwrap byokInferenceCostUsd | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Gateway balance · collection pending
panels.description: Last observation per gateway in the selected range, not a live billing balance. Shared gateway balance is independent of the organization filter.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | keep event,gateway,balance | event="ai.router.credits" | unwrap balance | __error__="" [$__range]) by (gateway)

panels.title: Top organizations by observed API requests

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (organizationId) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", organizationId="organizationId" | event="api.request.completed" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | organizationId!="" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top organizations by reported AI usage value
panels.description: Gateway charges plus BYOK inference value; not invoice cash paid. Requires attributable reported cost events.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (organizationId) (max by (organizationId,costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", organizationId="organizationId", costId="costId", costUsd="costUsd" | event="ai.cost.reported" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | organizationId!="" | costId!="" | unwrap costUsd | __error__="" [$__range]))))

count(max by (costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~"notra-history-database-.+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}", history_snapshot="20261010T113508391Z"} | json event="event", costId="costId", organizationId="organizationId", weight="weight" | event="history.geo.scan" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | unwrap weight | __error__="" [$__range])))

sum(max by (costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~"notra-history-database-.+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}", history_snapshot="20261010T113508391Z"} | json event="event", costId="costId", organizationId="organizationId", costUsd="costUsd" | event="history.geo.scan" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | unwrap costUsd | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: GEO scans with a reported cost

targets.expr: count(max by (costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~"notra-history-database-.+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}", history_snapshot="20261010T113508391Z"} | json event="event", costId="costId", organizationId="organizationId", costUsd="costUsd" | event="history.geo.scan" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | unwrap costUsd | __error__="" [$__range])))
